versions.changelog:
Initial release of Developer Productivity Bundle – an integrated toolkit for software teams.

- Combines code review, bug tracking, documentation generation, and deployment monitoring in one skill bundle.
- Offers automation for pull request code review, smart bug management, document generation, and 24/7 service monitoring.
- Includes configuration templates and example workflows for easy setup and integration with CI/CD.
- Features ready-to-use scripts for installation and GitHub integration.
- Chinese-language documentation and usage guides provided.
